decisions.reason: The client replaces a blog keyword but does not change the selected or proposed blog topics.
The source Event changes the separate blog-keyword selection; it does not necessarily alter the campaign keyword list or its existing back-to-school replacement.
Replacing a blog keyword does not change the requirement to produce three blog articles during the trial.
The search-volume requirement remains valid unchanged; the source does not modify its metrics obligation or necessarily place the blog keyword in the campaign keyword research sheet.
